question: Does the cap-1000 treatment arm still clear 98.2-100% on the amended engine?
instrument: benchmarks/run_paired_capacity_test.py :: run_paired_condition, treatment arm, max_predictions=1000, cycles 0-109
finding: The treatment arm holds and improves: 1.0000-1.0000 on all five seeds against 0.9821-1.0000 recorded on 89b0744, with 5 of 5 seeds clearing the threshold. The contrast the cap explains is narrower than the record implies, because the control arm is no longer near zero: on the amended engine it is 0.4821-0.7500 against 1.0000-1.0000, where the record had 0.0000-0.0268 against 0.9821-1.0000.
limits: Coverage is at its ceiling (112 of 112), so this says nothing about precision — the 0.3438 precision ceiling is a separate measurement and is untouched. Five diagnostic seeds only; no confirmatory seed was run. The tail differences between builds are in the asserted-set size (243-247 edges), not in world-edge coverage.
